properties.name: MEASURED before merge: 11 of 277, not the 5 a hand sweep found — and the four it missed are the reason the status-free rule is an enumeration
properties.statement:
MEASURED 2026-09-14 against reflow2's own committed export (4,467 nodes, 26,600 edges) with the shipped definition, before merge.

═══ THE NUMBER ═══
11 of 277 proposed Decisions, 4.0%. The design carried 34 open gaps in total at the time, so this is a third of them — a statement about how few gaps this design carries, not about how large the class is.

Across the 11 findings the promotion targets were 7 accepted Requirements, 2 realized Capabilities, 3 ChangeEvents and 1 DesignRule; several decisions carry two.

═══ ⭐ THE MEASUREMENT MOVED THE DEFINITION, TWICE ═══
The hand sweep that started this line of work found FIVE. The shipped definition finds ELEVEN, and the six-instance gap is the useful part:

(1) THREE ideas shipped inside ONE recorded change — `chg:alexs-four-surface-fixes-sequence-hint-get-node-by-id-auth-hint-and-bulk-check-only`, which answered four of Alex's surface complaints at once. A ChangeEvent carries no `status`, so a rule reading only statuses was blind to the single most common way an idea actually gets answered: somebody just built it. Counting ChangeEvent and DesignRule on their EXISTENCE — a change happened, a rule is in force — is what reaches them.

(2) TemporalFact is status-free too and is DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED. A measurement about an idea is evidence toward an answer, not the answer. That one exclusion is why the rule is an ENUMERATION of two types rather than the tempting "anything without a status", and it is pinned by a test.

The general lesson, not new here but earned again: A DEFINITION MEASURED BEFORE IT SHIPS IS A DIFFERENT DEFINITION FROM THE ONE MEASURED AFTER. The five-instance version would have shipped, reported a real number, and silently missed the most common case.

═══ FALSIFIED BOTH WAYS ═══
Run, not assumed. Disabling the sweep call: 5 of 10 tests fail — every positive. Widening the settled-status rule to accept any target: 3 of 10 fail — every exclusion. The two remaining are silence tests that cannot fail by construction (a parked question, and an answer nobody linked back), and the second exists to DOCUMENT the blind spot rather than to prove anything.

═══ WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH ═══
The size of the invisible half. Only promotions that drew the edge are reachable; 2 of the 7 found by hand carried nothing, and there is no way to count how many more are like them without reading 277 decisions. The 11 is a FLOOR on a population of unknown size, and the detector's own evidence line says so rather than reporting a number that sounds complete.
